rewrites.comment: SPA fallback. Prerendered pages (`/`, `/products`, every /products/<slug>, the trust pages) are static files and are served directly ahead of this rewrite, so crawlers still get real SSR HTML. Only routes with no prerendered file — dynamic ones like /orders/<id>, /checkout deep-links, admin/business, and products added after the last build — fall through to the client-rendered app shell here. trailingSlash:false serves clean URLs (matching the emitted canonical) without a redirect hop.
